author: barnabemonnot
content: that can give a good idea of the likely smallest nodes we have on the network https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/1569690422010191873/1570816644811460638

author: barnabemonnot
content: that said I'm not convinced we can make any kind of conclusion regarding raising requirements until we know what the network needs to support in the first place. e.g, we could be having 2x larger signatures if we need to support DVT. doesn't seem to me that we quite have the right models and simulations to make the decision, and I'd tread carefully with anything that raises the entry of validators on the network. as you know I believe there are good reasons to do so more generally speaking, but these are still delicate questions where the burden of proof is on increasing requirements
